data.name: Kanaram
data.gender_notes: Kanaram is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Kanara means 'servant of Lord Ganesha'. In Hindu mythology, Lord Ganesha is known as the remover of obstacles and the god of wisdom and knowledge. Kanaram is considered an assistant or attendant to Lord Ganesha, often depicted riding on his mouse vehicle. The name Kanaram carries the meaning “Lord Ganesha's attendant” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kanaram usually hope their child will grow to embody lord ganesha's attendant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Kanaram belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord Ganesha's attendant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kanaram total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.spiritual_significance: The name Kanaram holds great spiritual significance as it highlights an individual's dedication and devotion to Lord Ganesha, often viewed as a wise and compassionate deity. In Hindu teachings, becoming a servant or attendant to God is seen as the highest form of spiritual realization and ultimate goal in life. Thus, the name Kanaram signifies an individual's humility, selflessness, and devotion to the divine.
